title: M.I.S.T.A.R. — My free browser strategy game inspired by Risk and WarGames is open for testing!
author: Immediate_Penalty891
selftext:
**M.I.S.T.A.R. — My free browser strategy game inspired by Risk and WarGames is open for testing!**

Hey everyone! I’m a solo developer building **M.I.S.T.A.R.**, with AI assistance, and I’d love to hear what you think.

It’s a real-time strategy game on a 3D globe: capture territories, connect cities to factories, build defenses, launch missiles and hack enemy infrastructure—all with an ’80s command-center atmosphere.

Each city holds just **three units**, so positioning and coordinated attacks matter more than building one huge army.

It’s **free, desktop browser only**, and you can jump in without registering. Optional accounts let you save and continue later.

You’re fighting AI for now, but multiplayer is the long-term goal as the community grows.

👉 **Play:** [https://mistargame.com](https://mistargame.com)

Still a beta, so honest feedback is very welcome. What would make you want to play another round?
